items.title: 'It's not a good relationship, it's a deal for money' - Emery on Villa-Chelsea moves
items.description: Unai Emery insists that there are no "good relations" between Chelsea and Aston Villa after a series of transfers between the clubs.

items.title: Given credits Farke's second-half tactical shift in Brentford draw
items.description: Match of the Day pundit Shay Given commends Leeds United's second-half tactical shift after Dominic Calvert-Lewin struck late to salvage a 1-1 draw with Brentford.

items.title: Can Chelsea win the league with three at the back? Given's verdict
items.description: Match of the Day pundit Shay Given praises Chelsea's flying wing-backs, backing Xabi Alonso's side to win the Premier League title using a three-at-the-back system.

items.title: MOTD pundits debate controversial own goal in Man Utd victory
items.description: Match of the Day pundits Ellen White and Shay Given discuss the refereeing controversy at Old Trafford whereby a loophole allowed a Harry Maguire handball to stand as a Jacob Greaves own goal.

items.title: 'He's on it all the time' - White praises 'unbelievable' Fernandes
items.description: Match of the Day pundit Ellen White labels Bruno Fernandes "unbelievable", after the midfielder's hat-trick in Manchester United's 5-2 comeback win against Ipswich Town.
